purpose: Val frames inspected when choosing between restorer modes. src/eval_restorer_map.py excludes them from every mAP comparison.
how_used: Restored with Vihaan's tiling (overlap 128), then with overlap 384 and whole-frame. PSNR, SSIM and seam visibility on these five frames motivated src/restore_seamless.py and its two modes.
data_version: v1 glared frames (data/glared_full) with KITTI val clean originals. v2 regenerates glare for the same KITTI val IDs, so the scene content was seen and the IDs are excluded.
detector_used: none: no detection was run on these frames
